description: Suno's official music platform. An official REST API portal is available at platform.suno.com, but its authenticated contract is not represented by the former third-party sunoapi.org adapter.
prompt_training_notes: Suno says it may use user activity information, submissions, interactive chat information, and other content to improve its services, including to train and enhance the models that power them.

sources.notes: Official authenticated Suno API portal; public page confirms songs, covers and mashups through REST but does not expose the signed-in wire reference.

verification.notes: False third-party sunoapi.org execution registration removed. Native implementation remains blocked until the official authenticated API contract can be verified.
